hypothesis.claim: The tied rank-8 D arm's strictly causal next-bit FTRL update lowers exact arithmetic-coded payload relative to P, K, O, R, and S while preserving exact inverse, package, disk, and memory boundaries.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject v4 if C/P or P/K identity fails, D does not beat every control, any inverse/repeat/receipt fails, arithmetic is nonfinite, incremental package exceeds 65,536 bytes, scratch is memory-backed or exceeds 100,000,000,000 bytes, cleanup fails, or process-tree RSS exceeds 9,765,625 KiB.

changedMechanism: Replace v3's one delayed midpoint mean-gradient step with a decoder-synchronized online rank-8 FTRL update normalized by diagonal local Gauss-Newton curvature after every eligible coded bit.
invariants: The external cmix-obias source, model blob, preprocessing, coder, persistent parent updates, and package boundary remain unchanged.
The adapter used for bit t depends only on probabilities, recurrent state, and truths from bits preceding t in the current 512-bit segment.
Native bit-head hidden and cell state reset every 64 coded bits remains unchanged.
Every arm uses the identical PPM budget-zero residency policy and disk-backed scratch boundary.
No PRNG, coefficient blob, future truth, encoder-only state, external teacher, or uncounted model is available.
Exact repeat archive, canonical inverse, package accounting, cleanup, storage, and process-tree RSS receipts are mandatory.

population.unit: raw enwik9 bytes encoded through the complete reversible pipeline
population.selection: Opening 250KB joint diagnostic; every larger scope requires a separate prospectively frozen successor.
population.coordinate: Post-preprocessing coded-bit stream in 512-bit segments; adapter update follows each decoder-visible eligible truth and first affects the next bit.

measurements.definition: Every arm restores the exact frozen population.
Every arm repeats payload and archive byte-identically.
C and P payload bytes are identical.
P and K probability, state, and payload receipts are identical.
D payload is smaller than P, K, O, R, and S.
All adapter receipts are finite and active controls are nonzero.
Every process-tree peak is at most 9,765,625 KiB.
Every arm uses non-memory-backed scratch with peak allocation from zero through 100,000,000,000 bytes.
Incremental required package bytes are at most 65,536.
All bounded scratch is removed after terminal receipts.
